items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: Montague played with me, too. Sidney Montague, yeah.

ctx.x: I just wondered. I'd forgotten about that. You've had several drummers down there, I think, too. I don't remember who's been there through the years. Where? At the Harmony Inn, now that I think about it. Yeah. Let's see. Did Montague play with you for a while?
He did, yeah. Montague played with me, too. Sidney Montague, yeah. Mm-hmm.
He comes back to you when you think about it.
